limitations: HTML and CSS preview strings are intentionally empty: the implementation is native Slint.
Native control colors, radii, hover, focus, and selection values are owned by Fluent and are not extracted as application tokens.
No synthesized tonal ramps, web breakpoints, or custom motion values are recorded.
This is a provisional implementation record, not a user-approved production brand.

narrative.overview:
This records the implemented Windows Slint evidence viewer. Evergreen and sage provide a quiet reading field, with amber reserved for source provenance and uncertainty. Standard Fluent controls provide familiar desktop interaction. These are provisional implementation choices, not a user-approved brand system.

The visual signature is continuity between an application, its stable process identity, and the exact source events behind a review signal. The interface keeps evidence copyable and distinguishes synthetic, imported, and static evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Native controls and a restrained operational layout.
Explicit Root, Child, and Unresolved process labels.

rules.name: The Provenance Rule
rules.body: Amber identifies evidence source or uncertainty; red identifies a failed operation, not an inferred malware verdict.

rules.name: The Readable Identity Rule
rules.body: Process IDs, boot IDs, start keys, hashes, and source-event IDs remain readable and copyable text. Display PID values as plain numbers or explicit unavailable states.

rules.name: The Working Space Rule
rules.body: Size the review list to its actual rows, capped at 76 px, and collapse it when empty so the process and detail panes retain space.

dos: Do keep synthetic, imported, and static evidence visibly distinguished.
Do keep stable process identity and source-event IDs with their details.
Do preserve standard Fluent interaction states and keyboard affordances.
Do give the scrolling evidence panes the available working space.
donts: Don't use an empty review list to reserve unused vertical space.
Don't imply that an unresolved process has a known parent.
Don't turn a review signal or an empty finding list into a safety verdict.
Don't treat this provisional record as an approved production brand.
